composition.name: Ledger Grid
composition.scale: uniform small type, few size jumps
composition.density: high and even — tabular rows and columns
composition.hierarchy: flat with rank cues (position, weight), not size

signature.text: Tables and rules use box-drawing characters as borders

composition.name: Frieze Bands
composition.scale: band-sized — each band sets its own scale
composition.hierarchy: band order + band height carry importance
composition.ground: each band is its own ground; edges are hard
composition.dominantElement: the rhythm of varied band heights

signature.text: Every image is masked to the same irregular polygon derived from the logo

composition.name: Marginalia
composition.scale: steady text column, small margin apparatus
composition.density: dense column beside an airy margin
composition.hierarchy: main column leads; margin annotates and cross-references
composition.ground: book page — the margin is working space, not padding

signature.text: The accent color appears ONLY on the current nav item and the primary CTA — nowhere else

composition.name: Poster Bleed
composition.scale: one full-bleed image or letterform at viewport scale
composition.density: minimal copy pinned to edges and corners
composition.symmetry: edge-anchored, center deliberately vacant or occupied by the bleed
composition.hierarchy: the bleed is the message; text is caption-rank

signature.text: All interactive elements share one hard offset shadow that shifts on press

output.contract: The model justifies and executes this dealt hand — it does not re-choose. Rejected hand: re-deal with --reroll N+1; both deals stay recorded in used-dna.json.
